messages:
tom.sales: Heads up team — MedixCare (large ambulatory EHR) wants a 2-week pilot focused on auth/provisioning. Requirements: SAML (IdP + SP testing), SCIM (bulk import + delta PATCH), group->role mapping, multi-tenant domain allowlist, and strict data residency for EU tenants. They estimate ~3M tokens/mo and ~50k active users in pilot. Need SOC2/BAA + KMS options.
sara.solutions: Key clarifiers: 1) Do they need account linking for existing local accounts? 2) Are they using ADFS or a cloud IdP?
tom.sales: They use a mix — primarily Okta and some on-prem ADFS. They want SSO to match existing usernames and avoid duplicate accounts.
mike.security: For ADFS/AD we should watch for NameID format quirks and support transient vs persistent NameIDs. Also for PHI we should propose Private deployment with HSM/KMS in their region for EU data residency. Need to confirm whether encryption-in-transit + at-rest compliance meets their legal team.
anya.devex: For account linking we can support `user.externalId` mapping during SCIM bulk import and on first SSO login do a match on email or externalId. Example SCIM CSV header we provide: `externalId,email,givenName,familyName,groups,tenantAlias`. Sample row: `mc-42,jane.doe@medixcare.eu,Jane,Doe,Physicians;Oncall,medix-eu`. We also provide a mapping JSON they can edit.
lucas.product: Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoff: Hosted is faster to spin up but Private/Dedicated needed if they require EU-only data plane + customer-managed KMS. Professional services for bulk import and group mapping are one-time. Make sure quote separates licensing, infra, and migration hours.
rachel.custsu: I'll collect SOC2 link and BAA template. Also confirm pen-test details.
sara.solutions: Operational checklist I propose: 1) exchange SAML metadata for each IdP, 2) confirm NameID and attribute statements (email, externalId, groups), 3) provision SCIM service account with least privilege and IP allowlist, 4) deploy DNS TXT verification per tenant alias, 5) run bulk import followed by live delta sync tests, 6) validate RBAC enforcement in app flows.
mike.security: Security asks to highlight to customer: - Encrypted SAML assertions available in Private (customer key). For Hosted we can accept signed assertions; encrypting requires sharing key material or working with a gateway. - Cert rotation cadence: recommend quarterly rotation and automated alerting. - SCIM service token lifetimes and scoped grants (PATCH, GET only) and audit logging.
anya.devex: SAML snippet for quick test (SP metadata we host):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sp.redwood.example/mc">
  <SPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://sp.redwood.example/mc/sso/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
This will let them do SP-initiated tests before IdP-initiated flows.
sara.solutions: For ADFS we should document a workaround: ADFS sometimes strips group claims; recommend using SCIM for authoritative group assignment and map fallback roles when group claims missing.
lucas.product: Pricing nuance: SCIM and SSO included in enterprise license; bulk import and custom group transforms are billable as professional services. Dedicated/Private pilot incurs extra infra/day and onboarding hours.
rachel.custsu: I'll attach BAA + SOC2 and add a short note about our incident response SLAs.
saml-bot: (automated) please upload IdP metadata xml to the shared drive and tag it with `medixcare-idp`.
tom.sales: Action items: Sara 1 — create POC runbook + pair for tests; Anya 1 — sample CSV + mapping JSON; Mike 1 — draft security appendix for proposal (KMS, cert rotation, EU residency); Lucas 1 — pricing split Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; Rachel 1 — SOC2/BAA artifacts. I'll intro MedixCare and ask for IdP metadata and sample user export. :thumbsup:
